parse.title: Ardougne Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Ardougne" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Recharge some [[Jewellery]] at the [[Totem Pole (Legends' Guild|Totem]] in the [[Legends' Guild|Legends Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Legends' Quest]]
*Less than fully charged [[skills necklace]] or [[combat bracelet]]
|-
|2. Enter the [[Wizards' Guild|Magic Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|66|link=y}}
|-
|3. Steal from a [[Chest (Ardougne Castle)|chest]] in [[Ardougne Castle]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|72|link=y}}
*[[Lockpick]] recommended
|-
|4. Have a [[Monkey minder|zookeeper]] put you in [[Ardougne Zoo]]'s monkey cage.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest
* [[Karamjan monkey greegree]]
|-
|5. Teleport to the [[Watchtower (building)|Watchtower]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Watchtower]]
*{{SCP|Magic|58|link=y}}
*Means to cast the [[Watchtower teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Earth=2|Law=2}})
|-
|6. Catch a [[Red salamander (Hunter)|Red Salamander]].
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|59|link=y}}
*[[Rope]] and [[small fishing net]]
|-
|7. Check the health of a [[Palm tree]] near [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|tree gnome village]].
''Note: This is the [[farming patch]] next to [[Gileth]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|68|link=y}}
*[[Palm sapling]], [[spade]] and a [[rake]]
*15 [[Papaya fruit]] recommended to pay the [[Gileth|gardener]]
|-
|8. Pick some [[Poison Ivy berries]] from the patch south of [[Ardougne]].
''Note: This patch is located next to the [[Ardougne Monastery]].
|
*{{SCP|Farming|70|link=y}}
*[[Poison ivy seed]], [[seed dibber]] (or [[Barbarian Farming]]), and a [[rake]]
''Note: Poison ivy cannot get diseased while growing.''
|-
|9. Smith a [[Mithril platebody]] near [[Ardougne]].
''Note: You'll have to use the [[Port Khazard]], [[Yanille]], or [[West Ardougne]] [[anvil]] for this.''
|
*{{SCP|Smithing|68|link=y}}
*5 [[mithril bar]]s and a [[hammer]]
|-
|10. Enter your [[Player-owned house|POH]] from [[Yanille]].
|
*{{SCP|Construction|50|link=y}}{{Boostable|no}}
*25,000 [[coins]] for an [[estate agent]] to move your house to [[Yanille]]
''Note: In Deadman Mode, the task is instead "Ask the Estate Agent to move your house to Yanille." This does not cost anything as your house will not be moved.''
|-
|11. Smith a [[Dragon sq shield]] in [[West Ardougne]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Plague City]]
*{{SCP|Smithing|60|link=y}}
*[[Shield left half]], [[shield right half]] and a [[hammer]]
|-
|12. Craft some [[Death rune]]s from Essence.
''Note: Entering the [[Death Altar]] from the [[Mourner Headquarters]] is not recommended after the quest. It follows a lengthy route that requires [[mourner gear]], the [[crystal trinket]], the [[new key]], and a [[death talisman]]/[[Death tiara|tiara]] or [[catalytic talisman]]/[[Catalytic tiara|tiara]]. It's even possible to lock yourself out of this entrance with the light puzzle, which may require you to enter it via the [[Abyss]] or through the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] anyway to change the rotation of the mirrors again.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Mourning's End Part II]]
*{{SCP|Runecraft|65|link=y}}
*[[Pure essence|Pure]] or [[daeyalt essence]]
**''Note: Crafting runes using [[Guardian essence]] will '''NOT''' complete this achievement''
*Access to the [[Death Altar]] via the [[Abyss]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Ardougne cloak 3]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[farming patch]] at the [[Ardougne farm]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Wizard Cromperty]] offers you 150 [[noted]] [[pure essence]] for free every day
*[[Watchtower Teleport]] can now be used to teleport to [[Yanille]] instead
*10% increased chance of successfully [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocketing]] anywhere around [[Gielinor]]
*Hold up to 84 [[coin pouch]]es at a time, up from 56
